```{r}
library(anndataR)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(slingshot)
library(dplyr)
library(igraph)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(tidyr)
```

```{r}
adata <- read_h5ad("2.5_car_no_gd.h5ad", as = "SingleCellExperiment")
adata
```

```{r}
outcome_info <- c("P01"="persistence","P02"="persistence", "P03"="persistence", "P05"="persistence", "P06"="persistence", "P08"="no_persistence", "P09"="no_persistence",
"P10"="no_persistence", "P11"="no_persistence", "P13"="no_persistence")

adata$outcome <- outcome_info[as.character(adata$Patient)]

```

```{r}
dimred <- reducedDim(adata, "X_umap")
clustering <- adata$labels
counts <- assay(adata, "counts")
```

```{r}
set.seed(61)
sce <- SingleCellExperiment(
  assays = list(counts = counts)
)

reducedDim(sce, "UMAP") <- dimred
colData(sce)$labels <- clustering

sce <- slingshot(
  sce,
  clusterLabels = "labels",
  reducedDim = "UMAP",
  start.clus = c("Product Mixed T", "Product CD8+ T"),
  allow.breaks=T,
  omega=T,
  stretch=1,
  approx_points=300
)
```

### summary of results
```{r}
SlingshotDataSet(sce)
```

```{r}
mst <- slingMST(sce)

nodes <- data.frame(
  cluster = V(mst)$name,
  do.call(rbind, vertex_attr(mst, "coordinates"))
)

colnames(nodes)[2:3] <- c("UMAP_1", "UMAP_2")

nodes
```

```{r}
edge_list <- as.data.frame(get.edgelist(mst))

colnames(edge_list) <- c("from", "to")
```

```{r}
edges <- edge_list %>%
  left_join(
    nodes %>% dplyr::rename(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2),
    by = c("from" = "cluster")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    nodes %>% dplyr::rename(xend = UMAP_1, yend = UMAP_2),
    by = c("to" = "cluster")
  )

edges
```

```{r}
cell_df <- data.frame(
  UMAP_1 = reducedDim(sce, "UMAP")[,1],
  UMAP_2 = reducedDim(sce, "UMAP")[,2],
  labels = sce$labels
)

p <- ggplot(cell_df, aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2)) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = labels), size = 0.3) +
  geom_segment(
    data = edges,
    aes(
      x = x,
      y = y,
      xend = xend,
      yend = yend
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 1.2,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
    geom_point(
    data = nodes,
    aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 4,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = palette) +
  theme_classic()
p
ggsave(plot=p, filename = "car_only/pseudotime_MST_umap.png", dpi = 300, height = 6, width = 8)
```

```{r}
curves <- slingCurves(sce)
curves
```

```{r}
curve_dfs <- lapply(seq_along(curves), function(i) {

  crv <- curves[[i]]

  data.frame(
    UMAP_1 = crv$s[,1],
    UMAP_2 = crv$s[,2],
    lineage = paste0("Lineage_", i),
    order = seq_len(nrow(crv$s))
  )
})

curve_df <- do.call(rbind, curve_dfs)
curve_df$lineage <- gsub("_", "", curve_df$lineage)
curve_df <- filter(curve_df, lineage %in% c("Lineage1", "Lineage2", "Lineage3"))
```


```{r}
lin <- slingLineages(sce)

terminal_cluster <- sapply(lin, tail, 1)
```

```{r}
p <- ggplot(cell_df, aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2)) +

  # --- cells (cluster colour scale 1)
  geom_point(
    aes(colour = labels),
    size = 1, alpha = 0.8, shape = 20
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = palette) +

  ggnewscale::new_scale_colour() +

  # --- lineages (second independent colour scale)
  geom_path(
    data = curve_df,
    aes(
      UMAP_1,
      UMAP_2,
      group = lineage
    ),
    colour="grey30",
    linewidth = 1,
    arrow = arrow(type = "closed", length = unit(0.15, "inches"))
  ) +
  theme_classic()
p
ggsave(plot=p, filename = "car_only/pseuodtime_lineages_umap.png", dpi = 300, height = 6, width = 8)
```

### add lineage info to cell_df to be able to plot on umap
```{r}
pt <- slingPseudotime(sce)
cell_df$pt_L1 <- pt[, "Lineage1"]
cell_df$pt_L2 <- pt[, "Lineage2"]
cell_df$pt_L3 <- pt[, "Lineage3"]
```
```{r}
pt_df <- as.data.frame(pt)
pt_df$cell <- rownames(pt_df)

pt_long <- tidyr::pivot_longer(
  pt_df,
  cols = starts_with("Lineage"),
  names_to = "lineage",
  values_to = "pseudotime"
)
pt_long <- merge(pt_long, cell_df, by.x = "cell", by.y = "row.names")
```

```{r}
pt_long <- filter(pt_long, lineage %in% c("Lineage1", "Lineage2", "Lineage3"))
p <- ggplot(pt_long, aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2, color = pseudotime)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~ lineage, ncol=1) +
  scale_color_viridis(option = "rocket", direction = -1) +
  theme_void()+
  theme(strip.text=element_text(size=14, colour = "black", face = "bold"))
p
ggsave(plot = p, filename= "catcar_pseudotime_gradient_umaps.png", dpi = 300, height = 6, width = 2)
```

# plot gene expression along lineages
```{r}
genes <- c("GATA3", "STAT6", "STAT5A", "IL4R", "TBX21", "NFKB2", "TGFB1", "IL10", "MYD88", "TGFBR3", "ISG15", "MX1", "MAML1", "RAD50", "EP300", "NOTCH1", "NOTCH2", "RELA", "NFKB1",
"CREM", "ETV3", "HDAC1", "KLF9", "PURA", "REST", "TLR2", "TLR3", "TLR4", "TLR5", "TLR7", "TLR9", "TLR10")

th2_genes <- c("GATA3", "STAT6", "MAML1", "EP300", "RAD50", "NOTCH1", "TBX21", "IRF4", "RORC")
qc_genes <- c("MKI67", "TOP2A", "ACTB", "B2M", "MALAT1", "CCR7", "GZMA", "NFKB1", "IL7R")

expr_mat <- logcounts(sce)[th2_genes, ]

expr_long <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(t(expr_mat)))
expr_long$cell <- rownames(expr_long)

expr_long <- expr_long %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(all_of(th2_genes), names_to = "gene", values_to = "expression") %>%
  left_join(cell_df[, c("cell", "pt_L1", "pt_L3", "Patient", "Timepoint", "outcome")],
            by = "cell")

plot_input <- expr_long %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(c(pt_L1, pt_L3), names_to = "lineage", values_to = "pseudotime") %>%
  filter(!is.na(pseudotime)) %>%
  mutate(lineage = recode(lineage, pt_L1 = "L1 (persisting)", pt_L3 = "L3 (non-persisting)"))
```

```{r}
threshold <- 0.8

early_clusters <- c(
  "Product Mixed T",
  "Product CD8+ T",
  "Naive/CM T",
  "Cycling T"
)

cw <- slingCurveWeights(sce)
cell_df$Lineage1_weight <- cw[, "Lineage1"]
cell_df$Lineage3_weight <- cw[, "Lineage3"]

cell_df$Branch_member <- cell_df$Lineage1_weight > threshold &
                         cell_df$Lineage3_weight > threshold

# same as your Python: Branch cells in the early clusters get reassigned to "Other"
cell_df$Branch_member <- cell_df$Branch_member &
                         !(cell_df$labels %in% early_clusters)

branch_cells <- cell_df %>%
  filter(Branch_member) %>%
  mutate(pt_branch = (pt_L1 + pt_L3) / 2)

summary(abs(branch_cells$pt_L1 - branch_cells$pt_L3))

branch_band <- data.frame(
  xmin = min(branch_cells$pt_branch),
  xmax = max(branch_cells$pt_branch)
)
branch_band
```

```{r}
plot_input$group <- paste0(plot_input$lineage, "_", plot_input$outcome)
```

```{r}
p <- ggplot(plot_input, aes(pseudotime, expression, color = lineage, linetype = lineage)) +
  geom_rect(
    data = branch_band,
    aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "grey70", alpha = 0.3
  ) +
  geom_smooth(method = "gam", se =F)+
  facet_wrap(~gene, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("orange","mediumvioletred")) +
  #scale_colour_brewer(palette="Paired")+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size=14, face="bold"))
p
ggsave(plot=p, filename = "./car_only/th2_genes_over_pseudotime.png", dpi=300, height=6,width=10)
```
